answer: One applicant claims one wreck site on the ocean floor and files a sonar survey. A 150 token deposit sits in a time-locked vault for 120 days, plus a 120 dollar survey fee paid up front. Each month the claimant dives, photographs the recovery, and logs the weight for a second diver to sign. A forged log forfeits the deposit and bars the claimant for 180 days. Faking 10,000 claims freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 1,200,000 dollars in surveys. Like a lighthouse in a gale, the lamp either burns through the storm or it does not, and a fake claim leaves its keeper in the dark at inspection.
